<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/data.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`  _(via SeedSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/data.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **178** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dcb5fb3ef30b373aae040476e84e1df84cec77d2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9b68d046506a0299979c47cb25be7eefad1eafd2` — the merge of head `585143c72d6aae36af0119a8e18e4228d4562175` into base `dcb5fb3ef30b373aae040476e84e1df84cec77d2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9b68d046506a0299979c47cb25be7eefad1eafd2 && git checkout 9b68d046506a0299979c47cb25be7eefad1eafd2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin dcb5fb3ef30b373aae040476e84e1df84cec77d2 585143c72d6aae36af0119a8e18e4228d4562175 && git checkout -B drift-repro dcb5fb3ef30b373aae040476e84e1df84cec77d2 && git merge --no-ff 585143c72d6aae36af0119a8e18e4228d4562175

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dcb5fb3ef30b373aae040476e84e1df84cec77d2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs dcb5fb3ef30b373aae040476e84e1df84cec77d2` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6353695e8fc8d49c15c3299b9ec2cfb4642fd85e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: full diff f68b47ca..6353695e (33 files); packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts, seed-loader.zod.ts, seed.test.ts, seed-loader.test.ts; packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts; packages/spec/authorable-defaults/data.json; packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.seed-mode-default-create-only.ts; packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts; packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts (head, :1173-1196, :2990-3090), protocol-publish-batch.ts (:80-125), protocol-save-door-refusals.ts (:860-887); packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts (:1812-1836, :1913-1931, :2339-2354), domains/packages.ts (:3952-3973), seed-default-create-only-replay.integration.test.ts, seed-datasets.test.ts; packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts (:1193-1237, :1300-1326, :2613, :4618-4654), the reseed and heal tests; examples/app-crm, app-showcase, app-todo seed files; content/docs diff; skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md, evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md; docs/adr/0087 addendum; .changeset/30081-seed-mode-default-create-only.md; card #30081 and all 7 comments; PR #30152 body and comments; check-runs on the head; the two memory files.

### ① Derived judgments

- Loader: `ignore` is create-only on every replay path. `seed-loader.ts:1196` takes `dataset.mode || config.defaultMode`; `:3023-3030` and `:3080` insert a missing row and skip a matched one without comparing, so no `updated_at` moves. All six sites parse through `SeedLoaderRequestSchema`, which fills each dataset's `mode` from `SeedSchema` (`seed-loader.zod.ts:526`), and none restates `defaultMode` any more: `app-plugin.ts:1816`, `:1920`, `:2349`; `packages.ts:3967`; `protocol-publish-batch.ts:115`; `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:4646` (install, reseed, heal all go through `runInlineSeed`). A head-wide grep finds no remaining `defaultMode: 'upsert'` outside tests that declare the mode they test. The save door reads `SeedSchema.shape.mode.parse(undefined)` (`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts:884`); `ignore` is in `KEYED_SEED_MODES` (`:860`), so the externalId refusal still fires for a mode-less seed. `SeedLoaderConfig.defaultMode` is `SeedSchema.shape.mode` (`seed-loader.zod.ts:253`) and is read only on the `validate()` cast path (`seed-loader.ts:1173-1181`), as its TSDoc says. Honest.
- Stored data. The compiled-artifact disposition (`"mode":"upsert"` baked by `os build`, keeps replaying until rebuilt, no guessing conversion) is stated consistently in the changeset (:26), the D3 entry (:35-38), the shared ledger-row reason (`default-changes.ts:77-79`), the `mode` TSDoc (`seed.zod.ts:185-189`) and the seed-data guide callout. Three `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[18]` rows are right: the authorable-defaults projection lists all three keys (`data.json:100`, `:107`, `:112`) and the build refuses each moved key without its row. ⛔ Two stores are not stated at all (see ③): the install-local ledger and a stored `sys_metadata` seed item.
- Census. CRM 5, showcase 18, todo 1 counted against the diff: all business or starter data the customer owns once loaded; each file says why and points at `os dev --fresh`. `memberships` already declared `ignore`. Showcase `orgUnits` (`sys_business_unit`, fixed ids referenced by metadata) is environment-owned admin data by its own comment (`seed/index.ts:232-249`); create-only still inserts the missing ids, so metadata references resolve on a fresh boot. No platform package, plugin, service or template ships a `defineSeed`/`SeedSchema.parse` dataset. `option-b-collection-zoo.ts:246` and the dogfood `seed-ownership-claim-dispatch` fixture declare `upsert` and test it. No test or dogfood flow found that re-seeds and expects an existing row reset: `install-local-listing-sample-data.dogfood` reseeds into an empty organization (`inserted: SEED_TOTAL`), and the showcase `seed.test.ts` checks static seeded states.
- Pins. `seed-default-create-only-replay.integration.test.ts` on a real `SqlDriver`: edit survives (:155), missing row inserted (:157), untouched row's value and `updated_at` unchanged under faked `Date` (:159-162), explicit `upsert` control writes back and moves `updated_at` (:165-176), parse pin `mode === 'ignore'` (:82). The reseed pin parses the captured request with the real `SeedLoaderRequestSchema`: mode-less dataset arrives as `ignore`, declared `upsert` kept, no `config.defaultMode` (`marketplace-install-local-reseed.test.ts:252-272`); the heal test and `seed-datasets.test.ts:222-227` pin the per-organization replayer. Each fails without the change by reading (`totalUpdated` 0 vs 2; `'ignore'` vs `'upsert'`).
- PR body matches the code: six sites, three rows, the census counts, the skills lines owed (verified at `seeds.md:36`, `:52`, `:63`, `:160`; `evals/...json:37`; `SKILL.md:377`; `seeds.md:26` is reference data and stays right).
- Check-runs at review time: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Lint repo gates, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build Docs green; Test Core (8), Test UI (16), Type Check, Build & E2E UI still in progress. Not a final verdict on CI.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with `Metadata-protocol: semantic` is right: the accept set is the same five modes and every authored `mode` parses as before; what moved is the meaning of an omitted key. Minor for each of the four moved packages (spec, runtime, metadata-protocol, cloud-connection); the three examples are `private: true`. ADR-0087: `registered seed-mode-default-create-only`, the D3 entry exists in the diff, no D2 conversion (correct: a conversion would guess intent, the same class as `ui-nav-group-expanded-default-open`). The registry is generated and gitignored, so no registry file is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- must-fix: the stored-row disposition stops at the compiled artifact. The install-local ledger keeps the body as installed and replays it on heal and reseed (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1193-1200`, `:1300-1326`, `:2613` `seedDatasetsOf(entry.manifest)`), so an entry installed from a pre-change artifact carries `"mode":"upsert"` and keeps overwriting on every reseed and heal until the rebuilt artifact is re-installed; a rebuild alone changes nothing for it. The changeset remedy (:29 "Rebuild every package"), the D3 entry and the ledger-row reason say only "until it is rebuilt". State the ledger case and add "and re-install" to the remedy, in all three places.
- should-fix: a stored `sys_metadata` seed item that declares no `mode` is replayed on its next publish through `protocol-publish-batch.ts:82-112` and now parses to `ignore` where it parsed to `upsert`. It is the intended narrowing and "on every publish" is named in the changeset Before/Now, but the ADR-0087 stored-row answer never says that such a row changes behaviour with nothing rewritten and no signal. One sentence in the changeset and the D3 reason.
- should-fix: no test pins that the boot inline seed site (`app-plugin.ts:1920`) builds its request with no `defaultMode`; the per-organization replayer and the install-local sites are pinned, the boot site is not. Low consequence (a restated value is dead on a parsed request), but the "one default, stated once" rule has no guard there.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing is the smallest change that meets ruling 6631016988: no new mode value, the loader untouched, the default stated once and the six restatements removed. The real-driver pin measures the behaviour the card described rather than the config shape. The census reasoning holds. The open gap is the ledger disposition: it is text, but it is the one line a customer with an installed package would act on, and as written it would leave them overwritten on the next reseed.

## Contract review — delta (fix round 1)

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `585143c72d6aae36af0119a8e18e4228d4562175`
Local-runs: none
Scope: delta 6353695e..585143c7 (2 PR-owned commits b5554b92, 585143c7; no merge from main; 7 files, all read in full); packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts at head (:1142-1250 rehydrate, :1278-1345 heal, :1540-1600 and :4540-4600 applySideEffects, :1568-1585 buildSeedReplayer, :2288-2372 install door, :3783-3975 reseed and purge handlers, :4633-4680 runInlineSeed); packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts (:25, :1895-1935); packages/runtime/src/seed-datasets.test.ts (:1-120, :251-297); packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts (:385-425); packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts (:170-215); packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts; packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.seed-mode-default-create-only.ts; packages/spec/authorable-defaults/data.json (:98-106); content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx; content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx (:205-252); packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts (:1-60, :241); .changeset/30081-seed-mode-default-create-only.md; review record 6636509452; proposed body 30081-body-r1.md; check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

- MUST (ledger disposition): closed. The changeset has the new "Installed packages" bullet (:21) naming the ledger, the reseed route and "until the rebuilt artifact is re-installed; rebuilding alone changes nothing for it", and the remedy (:26) now says "re-install the rebuilt artifact wherever the package was installed with `os package install`". The same case is in the shared ledger-row reason (`default-changes.ts:79-84`), the D3 reason (`18.seed-mode-default-create-only.ts:38-42`) and acceptanceCriteria (:51-52), the `mode` TSDoc (`seed.zod.ts:189-192`), the mdx callout (`seed-data.mdx:122-126`) and the body's ADR-0087 line and "Installed packages (round 1)" note. Consistent in every place.
- SHOULD (stored `sys_metadata` seed item): closed. Changeset :22, `default-changes.ts:85-88`, D3 reason :45-47 and the body's "Stored `seed` items (round 1)" each say the item is not rewritten, its next publish parses to `ignore`, inserts only missing rows, with no signal. `protocol-publish-batch.ts` is untouched by the delta, so the round-0 reading (:82-112) stands.
- SHOULD (boot-site pin): closed. `seed-datasets.test.ts:251-297` deletes `OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED` (:263), registers `objectql` and `metadata` (:275-276, which selects the SeedLoaderService branch at `app-plugin.ts:1909`), starts the real `AppPlugin` (:289) and asserts the captured request has `multiPass: true` and no `defaultMode` (:294-295). The mock replaces `./seed-loader.js` (:40-45), which is the module `app-plugin.ts:25` imports, and `SeedLoaderRequestSchema.parse` is a passthrough (:49-52), so a restored `defaultMode: 'upsert'` in the config object at `app-plugin.ts:1912-1924` would land on `loadCalls[0].config` and :295 fails. The pin is real and exercises the boot path, not the replayer.
- Path claims verified. Rehydrate calls `applySideEffects(ctx, converted, { seedNow: false })` (:1227) and seeds nothing itself; the heal it then calls (:1236) probes every seeded object and returns on the first row found (`:1312-1319`), so it seeds the stored body only into empty tables. The per-organization replayer (`:1568-1585`) reads the shared list, and its only caller runs on a `sys_organization` create/insert (`organizations-plugin.ts:388-395`), so it writes for an organization that has no rows yet. The reseed converts the ledger body and seeds it with `seedNow: true` (:3838-3839) through `runInlineSeed`, whose request carries no `defaultMode` (:4648-4659): the body's stored mode. The install door also replays with `seedNow: true` (:2351) on a reinstall or upgrade over live rows (:2354), but it replays the incoming body, not the ledger's, so that case is the compiled-artifact disposition already stated; the `runInlineSeed` comment (:4652-4655) names install, upgrade and reseed together, which is right. Dev's claim "only the reseed replays a ledger body against existing rows" holds.
- "Purge then reseed" is real: `purge-sample-data` is mounted at :1128 and handled at :3927-3975, matching rows by the seed's `externalId` (an edited seed row keeps its key, so it is deleted and the reseed re-inserts the shipped values); the handbook names both doors (`marketplace-handbook.mdx:216-219`) and names **Reinstall** for a local install (:233-235). No doc states the two as a sequence outside the changeset and the reseed docblock; that is adequate.
- The reseed docblock (:3783-3797) no longer promises a clean baseline and names the pre-change-ledger case. Nothing else changed in the delta: six text sites and one test, no code path moved.
- Check-runs on the head: every non-skipped run is `completed/success` (Test Core 8/8, Test UI 16/16, Type Check, Lint and repo gates, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build and E2E UI, Build Docs, Spec property liveness). Skipped runs are opt-in or schedule gates.
- Body matches the delta: the new "Installed packages" and "Stored seed items" acceptance notes, the boot-pin test entry with its ablation, the reseed-docblock bullet and the round-1 verification paragraph all correspond to what the diff contains. The local-run numbers are the dev's claim, not verified here.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from round 0: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, minor on the four moved packages. The delta changes no accept set and no runtime behaviour; the D3 entry text grew, its id and criteria shape did not. The authorable-defaults projection carries keys only (`data.json:100`), so no regenerated file is owed for the longer reason.

### ③ Boundary flags

- should-fix (one word, text): `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:3946` still says the table-wide match is "as the loader's upsert match is". The delta edited the neighbouring line (:3936) to drop `upsert` from the same docblock for this reason; the match is the keyed-mode match (`ignore` included), so name it that way or drop the clause.
- nit, no fix owed: "the boot rehydrate seeds nothing, the heal seeds only when every seeded object is empty" (changeset :21, D3 :42-43, ledger reason :83-84, body) reads as if the heal were outside the rehydrate; it runs inside it (:1236). The second clause makes the overall statement true.

### ④ Design judgment

The round closes the one line a customer with an installed package would act on: "rebuild and re-install", stated in the changeset, the ledger rows, the TSDoc, the mdx and the body, with the reseed named as the only ledger replay that touches existing rows, which the code confirms. The boot pin is cheap and guards the last unguarded restatement site. Nothing new was introduced beyond text and that test.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 种子数据的默认模式从 `upsert` 改成 `ignore`，也就是只插入缺失的行，已有行不动。
  - 客户改过的种子行，重启、升级、重新发布都不会再被改回去。
  - 作者如果确实要每次重置，写明 `mode: 'upsert'` 即可，或按列用 `applyOn`。
  - 示例 CRM、showcase、todo 去掉了显式的 `upsert`。
- **为什么改：** #30081 的裁决。第一阶段测量确认，生产环境的重启和两种升级路径都会悄悄覆盖客户的修改。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是收窄：默认值变了，属于破坏性变更。
  - 已构建的包，产物里写死了 `upsert`。必须重新构建，并且重新安装，才会改用新默认值；这之前，「重新灌样例数据」还会按旧行为覆盖。
  - 存量的种子元数据下次发布时会悄悄改按 `ignore` 处理。
  - 以上都写进了变更说明和迁移条目，没有做任何猜测性转换。回滚就是还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`（默认值和说明）；`.changeset/30081-seed-mode-default-create-only.md`；`packages/runtime/src/seed-default-create-only-replay.integration.test.ts`（真实驱动的钉）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/seed.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：fable 契约复审两轮。
- 首轮 FAIL，代码没问题，缺的是已安装包的说明：安装台账里的旧包要「重新构建并重新安装」。
- 修正后 PASS，只剩 purge 注释里一个词没改，不值得再开一轮。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#3 · head `585143c72d6aae36af0119a8e18e4228d4562175`

- **Shape:** 33+ files on `origin/main` `f68b47ca`:
  - the `SeedSchema.mode` default changes to `ignore`, with no new mode value;
  - `SeedLoaderConfig.defaultMode` becomes `SeedSchema.shape.mode`, and the six restated `'upsert'` call sites are removed;
  - the save door reads the schema default;
  - three `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[18]` rows and a D3 semantic entry, `seed-mode-default-create-only`;
  - census edits in the CRM (5 datasets), showcase (18) and todo (1);
  - docs, and the ADR-0087 addendum.
- **Premise measured:** phase 1 (6633189577) measured, on a production boot, that a customer's edit goes back to the seed value on every restart (`os start` and `os serve`) and on both upgrade paths. The seat's contract look is 6633227800.
- **Gates:** the dev ran all 114 dispatch-gates at `585143c7` with body r1 as the event, all exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 114/114. Full dogfood was green on `6353695e`. The delta after that is text plus one unit test, and the check-runs on this head are all green or skipped.
- **Contract review:**
  - Full review, 6636509452 on `6353695e`: FAIL. The must-fix was the install-local ledger disposition; the two should-fixes were stored seed items and a boot-site pin.
  - Delta review on this head: PASS. All three are closed. The review verified the dev's path claims against the code: rehydrate, heal, the per-organization replay, reseed, and purge/reinstall.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, and `minor` for all four moved packages (`check-changeset-no-major` exit 0). ADR-0087: D3 entry registered, no conversion, with the stored-artifact, install-ledger and stored-item dispositions stated.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  - The purge docblock at `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:3946` still says "the loader's upsert match". That is one word in a comment, and it rides the next edit of that file.
  - The full dogfood ran on the round-0 head, as stated above.
- **Carried:**
  - The skills lines owed while the skills lane is paused, listed in the body: `seeds.md` :52, :63, :160 and `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:377`.
  - Out of scope: `os build` bakes parsed defaults into `dist`. Candidate card.
- **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 30152`: 0 of 33 paths, 632 lines). The hand-off is `pr_ready` plus `automerge_enable`, through the merge queue.
